sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook

sentences.zh: 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼（Zylran Mondani）以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, In the Democratic race for president, Joe Biden is being asked to confront a record on race
sentences.zh: 今天，在民主党总统初选竞选过程中，乔·拜登正被要求面对他在种族问题上的过往记录

sentences.en: that some in his party now see as outdated and unjuSt. A steadhorned on the policies Biden embraced and how they were viewed when he embraced them.
sentences.zh: 党内有些人现在认为这已经过时且不公正。民主党人一直在纠结于拜登曾支持的政策，以及在他拥护这些政策时它们是如何被看待的。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月3日，星期三。

sentences.en: I do not believe you are a raciSt. And I agree with you when you commit yourself to the importance of finding common ground.
sentences.zh: 我不认为你是个种族主义者，我也同意你对寻找共同点之重要性的承诺。

sentences.en: But I also believe, and it's personal, and I was actually very, it was hurtful to hear you talk about the reputations of two United States senators who built
sentences.zh: 但我也认为——这很私人，而且实际上我非常……听到你谈论两名美国参议员的名誉时，我感到很受伤，他们靠着

sentences.en: their reputations and career on the segregation of race in this country.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家按种族进行隔离来建立他们的名誉和职业生涯。

sentences.en: And it was not only that, but you also worked with them to oppose busing.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，你还曾与他们合作反对校车接送政策。

sentences.en: And, you know, there was a little girl in California who was part of the second class to integrate her public schools.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，加利福尼亚州曾有个小女孩，她是第二批进入公立学校实行种族融合的学生之一。

sentences.en: And she was bused to school every day.
sentences.zh: 她每天都被用校车送到学校。

sentences.en: And that little girl was me.
sentences.zh: 而那个小女孩就是我。

sentences.en: So I will tell you that on this subject, it cannot be an intellectual debate among Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉你们，在这个问题上，民主党人之间不能只进行理性的辩论。

sentences.en: We have to take it seriously.
sentences.zh: 我们必须严肃对待。

sentences.en: We have to act swiftly as attorney general counsel.
sentences.zh: 作为总检察长法律顾问，我们必须迅速行动。

sentences.en: A stead to the average American watching the debates last week, what do you think that this now famous confrontation between Joe Biden and Kamala Harris seemed to be about?
sentences.zh: 对于上周观看辩论的普通美国人来说，你认为乔·拜登和卡玛拉·哈里斯之间这场现在广为人知的交锋究竟是关于什么的？

sentences.en: Well, on its most literal level, it was two top tier Democrats having the most confrontational direct moment we've seen in the primary so far.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从最字面的层面上看，这是我们在初选中见过的两位顶级民主党人之间最具对抗性和最直接的时刻。

sentences.en: I want to have this campaign litigated on who supports civil rights and whether I did or not,
sentences.zh: 我希望这场竞选能够围绕谁支持民权来进行辩论，无论我是否支持过，

sentences.en: I'm happy to do that.
sentences.zh: 我都乐意这样做。

sentences.en: I was a public defender.
sentences.zh: 我曾是一名公设辩护人。

sentences.en: I didn't become a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 我没有去当检察官。

sentences.en: I came out and I left a good law firm to become a public defender.
sentences.zh: 我挺身而出，离开了一家优秀的律师事务所去担任公设辩护人。

sentences.en: When in fact, when in fact, when in fact, my city was in flames because of the assassination of Dr. King.
sentences.zh: 事实上，事实上，事实上，当时我的城市正因为马丁·路德·金博士遇刺而陷入火海。

sentences.en: But in the bigger, more abstract view, these were two different generations of Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但从更宏大、更抽象的角度来看，这是两代不同的民主党人。

sentences.en: One, a barrier-breaking, younger Black senator pushing the old guard, the senator who came in the
sentences.zh: 一位是打破常规、年轻的黑人女参议员，她在向老一辈发起挑战——即那些在

sentences.en: 1970s who had relationships with segregationists and avowed racists.
sentences.zh: 20世纪70年代进入政坛、与隔离主义者和公开的种族主义者有过交往的参议员。

sentences.en: She was pushing him on racial issues and trying to hold him accountable for how the Democratic Party has handled issues of race for decades leading up to this point.
sentences.zh: 她就种族问题向他施压，并试图让他为民主党几十年来如何处理种族问题承担责任。

sentences.en: But it also felt like this was about the details of a specific policy that Biden was a part of.
sentences.zh: 但这也让人感觉，这是关于拜登曾参与的一项具体政策的细节。

sentences.en: And most of us probably don't really understand what his intentions were or what the context of that policy was.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人可能并不真正理解他的意图是什么，或者该政策的背景是什么。

sentences.en: So take us back to that time.
sentences.zh: 那么，把我们带回那个时代。

sentences.en: Where was Joe Biden in his political career?
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登当时的政治生涯处于什么阶段？

sentences.en: Well, Joe Biden began as a lawyer in Wilmington and eventually a city counselor in the county.
sentences.zh: 嗯，乔·拜登最初是威尔明顿的一名律师，后来成为县市议员。

sentences.en: And he was emerging at a really racially contentious time within the city and state.
sentences.zh: 他在该市和该州种族矛盾非常激烈的时期崭露头角。

sentences.en: In April, after the murder of Martin Luther King, the National Guard was called out in several cities to put down riots.
sentences.zh: 4月，在马丁·路德·金被谋杀后，国民警卫队被召集到几个城市平息骚乱。

sentences.en: One of these cities was Wilmington, Delaware.
sentences.zh: 特拉华州威尔明顿就是其中之一。

sentences.en: But now in
sentences.zh: 但现在在

sentences.en: Wilmington, the National Guard is still on duty and the governor, Charles Terry, has no plan to send it back.
sentences.zh: 威尔明顿，国民警卫队仍在执勤，而州长查尔斯·特里（Charles Terry）没有计划将其撤回。

sentences.en: And Joe Biden runs for Senate in 1971 as a new type of Democrat.
sentences.zh: 1971年，乔·拜登作为一种新型民主党人竞选参议员。

sentences.en: I'm Joe Biden and I'm a candidate for the United States Senate.
sentences.zh: 我是乔·拜登，我是美国参议员候选人。

sentences.en: A Democrat who understands Black communities and has personal and deep relationships in those communities, but as a Democrat who can also unite the kind of outer portions of
sentences.zh: 一个理解黑人社区、并在这些社区拥有深厚个人关系的民主党人，但同时他也是一个能够团结该州外围地区的民主党人，

sentences.en: the state, which saw those issues very differently.
sentences.zh: 因为那些地区对这些问题的看法截然不同。

sentences.en: Politicians have done such a job on the people that the people don't believe them anymore.
sentences.zh: 政客们对人民做出了这样的事情，以至于人民不再相信他们了。

sentences.en: And I'd like a shot at changing that.
sentences.zh: 我想有机会改变这种状况。

sentences.en: Joe Biden himself tells a story about how he was the only lifeguard at a newly integrated pool in Wilmington.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登本人讲述过这样一个故事：他是威尔明顿一个新实现种族融合的游泳池里唯一的救生员。

sentences.en: I applied to the city of Wilmington for a job and for, I was the only white employee here.
sentences.zh: 我向威尔明顿市申请了一份工作，因为我是那里唯一的白人雇员。

sentences.en: And I learned so much.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多。

sentences.en: And I realized I lived in a neighborhood where I'd turn on the television and I'd see and listen to Dr. King and others.
sentences.zh: 我意识到我住在这样一个社区：我打开电视，看到并听到金博士和其他人的讲话。

sentences.en: But I didn't know any Black people.
sentences.zh: 但我并不认识任何黑人。

sentences.en: No, I really didn't.
sentences.zh: 不，我真的不认识。

sentences.en: You didn't know any white people either.
sentences.zh: 你也不认识任何白人。

sentences.en: That's the truth.
sentences.zh: 这就是事实。

sentences.en: It was part of his identity and part of his brand that he cared about civil rights, understood
sentences.zh: 关心民权、理解威尔明顿非裔美国人的困境，构成了他身份和政治品牌的一部分，

sentences.en: the plight of African-Americans in Wilmington, but also he understood that kind of outer white
sentences.zh: 但他也明白，特拉华州外围的白人群体当时确实被一种不满情绪所驱使。

sentences.en: Delaware was really motivated around grievance at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时特拉华州外围的白人群体确实被一种不满情绪所驱使。

sentences.en: In 1971, a group of Black students had filed a lawsuit in hopes to get the schools to further desegregate.
sentences.zh: 1971年，一群黑人学生提起诉讼，希望推动学校进一步实现种族融合。

sentences.en: And so the question of school segregation and school integration was very much on the forefront of the state's politics.
sentences.zh: 因此，学校种族隔离和学校种族融合的问题成为该州政治的核心议题。

sentences.en: And at the exact same time, that's when the young Joe Biden makes his way to Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，年轻的乔·拜登踏上了国会山。

sentences.en: And what was Biden's position when it came to desegregation?
sentences.zh: 那么拜登在废除种族隔离问题上的立场是什么？

sentences.en: Where the court has concluded that a school district, a state or a particular area has intentionally attempted to prevent Black or any group of people from attending a school,
sentences.zh: 如果法院得出结论，认为某个学区、某个州或特定区域蓄意企图阻止黑人或任何群体的人入学，

sentences.en: the court should and must declare that to be unconstitutional and thereby move from there to impose a remedy to correct the situation.
sentences.zh: 法院应该也必须宣布这是违宪的，并从那里开始实施补救措施以纠正这种情况。

sentences.en: Joe Biden takes the position, as many other politicians did at that time, that they were not opposed to the idea of integration.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登采取的立场是，正如当时许多其他政客一样，他们并不反对种族融合的理念。

sentences.en: What they're opposed to was the remedy.
sentences.zh: 他们反对的是补救方法。

sentences.en: I have argued that the least effective remedy to be imposed is the busing remedy.
sentences.zh: 我曾辩称，最无效的补救措施就是校车接送政策。

sentences.en: You get a court order in the late 70s that says that Delaware schools are too racially segregated and they must form a plan for racial integration.
sentences.zh: 你在70年代末收到了一项法院命令，称特拉华州的学校种族隔离现象过于严重，必须制定种族融合计划。

sentences.en: And a plan is instituted by the courts that says from the city in Wilmington, which is majority
sentences.zh: 法院制定了一项计划，规定来自以黑人为主的威尔明顿市以及市郊的

sentences.en: Black and the suburbs outside of it, that both those groups of students were for some portion of their schooling going to have to bus to the opposite community.
sentences.zh: 学生，在他们求学的某个阶段，都必须乘校车前往对方的社区上学。

sentences.en: So for the kind of inner city students, which are majority Black, they were going to have to go out to the suburbs for six
sentences.zh: 因此，对于市内的大多数黑人学生来说，他们必须去郊区上学六年，

sentences.en: years and the outer suburbs were going to have to come into Wilmington schools for about three years.
sentences.zh: 而外围郊区的学生则必须到威尔明顿的学校上学大约三年。

sentences.en: So this becomes the plan that's put in place that inflames those racial tensions on both sides of the state.
sentences.zh: 于是，这项实施的计划点燃了该州南北两地的种族紧张局势。

sentences.en: And what is Biden's opposition to that specific solution?
sentences.zh: 那么拜登对这个具体解决方案的反对意见是什么？

sentences.en: That the idea of integration was not a problem, but it was how the courts were forcing them to go about it.
sentences.zh: 融合的理念本身不是问题，问题在于法院强制他们实施这一理念的方式。

sentences.en: You have to think if you were a parent in the suburbs, which is almost exclusively white,
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑到，如果你是郊区的一个几乎全由白人组成的家庭的家长，

sentences.en: who had made that choice for your family almost entirely around the school district that your child was supposed to go into.
sentences.zh: 你为家庭做出选择时，几乎完全是围绕着你希望孩子去的学区进行的。

sentences.en: And then there is a court order that comes down that says not only are different people coming to that school,
sentences.zh: 然后法院下达了一项命令，不仅说不同背景的人要来这所学校，

sentences.en: but that your child is going to be put on a bus to a different school.
sentences.zh: 而且你的孩子将被送上前往另一所学校的校车。

sentences.en: That is the logic that those parents used to oppose the idea of busing.
sentences.zh: 这就是那些家长用来反对校车接送政策的逻辑。

sentences.en: And so at one point in 1975, Joe Biden says, the real problem with busing is you take people who aren't racist,
sentences.zh: 因此，在1975年的某个时刻，乔·拜登说，校车接送政策真正的问起在于，你把那些不带有种族主义色彩的人、

sentences.en: people who are good citizens, who believe in equal education and opportunity, and you stunt their children's intellectual growth by busing them to an inferior school,
sentences.zh: 那些好公民、那些相信平等教育和机会的人聚集起来，却通过把他们用校车送到一所劣质学校去阻碍了他们孩子的智力发育，

sentences.en: and you're going to fill them with hatred.
sentences.zh: 这会让他们心中充满仇恨。

sentences.en: So Biden is sympathizing with white parents in the suburbs who are suddenly feeling dislocated by this decision.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登是在同情郊区的白人家长，他们突然对这一决定感到无所适从。

sentences.en: But what about black parents in the city whose children would be bused to these theoretically better schools in the suburbs?
sentences.zh: 但是，对于市内那些孩子将被用校车送到郊区这些理论上更好的学校去的黑人家长呢？

sentences.en: What is Biden saying to them?
sentences.zh: 拜登对他们说了什么？

sentences.en: This is an important point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关键点。

sentences.en: Although the kind of white suburbs were almost uniformly against busing, somewhat because of the method and sometimes because of pure racism,
sentences.zh: 尽管白人郊区几乎一致反对校车接送，部分是因为方式问题，有时也纯粹是因为种族主义，

sentences.en: in black communities, particularly in Wilmington, there is not universal agreement on this issue.
sentences.zh: 但在黑人社区，特别是威尔明顿，在这个问题上并没有达成普遍共识。

sentences.en: There is universal consensus that integration is important and that their schools had not been adequately funded or not been adequately supported by the state.
sentences.zh: 大家普遍认为种族融合非常重要，而且他们的学校一直没有得到充足的资金或州政府的足够支持。

sentences.en: But when you look at polling and when you talk to people at the time, the actual issue of busing is controversial.
sentences.zh: 但当你查看民意调查并与当时的民众交谈时，校车接送这个具体问题是颇具争议的。

sentences.en: Remember, these parents themselves had to send their children further away into neighborhoods and communities that may have not always been welcoming to those students.
sentences.zh: 记住，这些家长自己必须把孩子送到更远的、可能并不总是欢迎这些学生的社区和邻里去。

sentences.en: So it wasn't universally loved.
sentences.zh: 所以它并不是普遍受人喜爱。

sentences.en: In one poll, about 40% of black parents supported the idea, 40% were against it, around 20% were unsure.
sentences.zh: 在一项民意调查中，大约40%的黑人家长支持这个想法，40%反对，大约20%不确定。

sentences.en: Joe Biden tries to take a nuanced position where sometimes it seems like he is a vocal opponent of the idea of busing and that he is signaling to kind of white Delaware that he is their advocate.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登试图采取一种微妙的立场，有时他似乎是校车接送政策的直言不讳的反对者，并向特拉华州的白人群体发出信号，表明他是他们的代言人。

sentences.en: And on the issue that the argument is about, and that is whether or not busing serves a, is A, required constitutionally, and B, has a utilitarian value for desegregation,
sentences.zh: 而关于争论的核心问题——即校车接送是否在宪法上被要求，以及它是否对种族融合具有实用价值，

sentences.en: I come down on the side of A, it is not constitutionally required, and B, it is not a useful tool.
sentences.zh: 我的结论是：A，宪法没有要求这样做；B，它并不是一个有用的工具。

sentences.en: But there's other times when he sounds very much like many of the black leaders in Wilmington who say, I don't know if I like this remedy,
sentences.zh: 但也有其他时候，他听起来非常像威尔明顿的许多黑人领袖，他们说：我不知道我是否喜欢这个补救办法，

sentences.en: but I do know that the issue of integration is really important.
sentences.zh: 但我确实知道种族融合这个问题非常重要。

sentences.en: So he's kind of firmly in the middle.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上坚守在中间立场。

sentences.en: And that kind of middle ground is something we see him stake on a number of issues, most notably crime,
sentences.zh: 这种中间立场我们在他对待许多问题的态度上都能看到，最显着的莫过于犯罪问题，

sentences.en: where he takes the kind of position and relies on those personal relationships with black communities,
sentences.zh: 他在该问题上采取某种立场，并依赖与黑人社区的个人关系，

sentences.en: while, according to his critics, legislating in the interest of white ones.
sentences.zh: 而据他的批评者所说，他立法时却是在迎合白人社区的利益。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免费解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Joe Biden takes the middle ground or the middle ground for that time on busing.
sentences.zh: 所以，乔·拜登在校车接送问题上采取了折中或符合那个时代的中间立场。

sentences.en: How do we then see that in his approach to crime?
sentences.zh: 那么我们如何从他对待犯罪的态度中看到这一点呢？

sentences.en: This one's a little different because while Biden on busing was seen as a kind of emblematic of the larger Democratic stance, with crime,
sentences.zh: 这一点略有不同，因为虽然拜登在校车接送问题上被视为更大范围的民主党立场的象征，但在犯罪问题上，

sentences.en: he was really kind of pushing the boundaries.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是在打破常规。

sentences.en: At that time, particularly in the 80s and 90s, was a kind of moral panic happening throughout the country.
sentences.zh: 在那个时期，特别是80和90年代，全国上下正经历着一种道德恐慌。

sentences.en: Crack.
sentences.zh: 快克可卡因。

sentences.en: The most addictive form of cocaine is now sweeping New York.
sentences.zh: 这种最容易让人上瘾的可卡因形式正在席卷纽约。

sentences.en: Around the explosion of drugs in cities.
sentences.zh: 围绕着城市中毒品的泛滥。

sentences.en: It's going nationwide, especially among the young.
sentences.zh: 它正在全国蔓延，在年轻人中尤其严重。

sentences.en: A drug so pure and so strong, it might just as well be called crack of doom.
sentences.zh: 一种如此纯净且强效的毒品，简直可以被称为毁灭的快克。

sentences.en: And the violent crime that often associated and came with them.
sentences.zh: 以及随之而来的暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: And Biden, as someone who had come up in Wilmington, a community that was experiencing these things closely, he had black community leaders, neighbors of his,
sentences.zh: 而拜登作为在威尔明顿成长起来的人——一个亲历这些现象的社区，他有黑人社区领袖和邻居

sentences.en: saying the issue was very important, but that they were looking at kind of root cause problems of why crime was happening.
sentences.zh: 告诉他，这个问题非常重要，但他们关注的是犯罪发生原因的根本问题。

sentences.en: They were talking about issues like education or job opportunities and the like.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的是教育、就业机会等问题。

sentences.en: When the outer Wilmington, in the kind of all white suburbs, you were hearing a more vocal cry for increasing cops, increasing prisons,
sentences.zh: 而在威尔明顿外围的全白人郊区，你听到的是对增加警察、增加监狱的更强烈呼声，

sentences.en: and really cracking down on those tough on crime measures that came to the cities.
sentences.zh: 并真正采取那些对犯罪采取强硬态度的措施。

sentences.en: So again, Biden is caught between political problem, but also one that's divided pretty clearly on racial lines.
sentences.zh: 所以，拜登再次陷入了政治难题之中，这个问题也沿着种族界限被划分得相当清楚。

sentences.en: And so what does he do?
sentences.zh: 那么他做了什么？

sentences.en: The truth is, every major crime bill since 1976 that's come out of this Congress has had the name of the Democratic senator from the state of Delaware, Joe Biden, on that bill.
sentences.zh: 事实是，自1976年以来国会通过的每一项重大犯罪法案，上面都写着来自特拉华州的民主党参议员乔·拜登的名字。

sentences.en: So there's this split screen of Joe Biden that you often hear about when you talk to people in Wilmington.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你与威尔明顿的人交谈时，你经常会听到关于乔·拜登的这种双重印象。

sentences.en: There is the neighbor who would go to black churches, would know the kind of leaders by name and the issues they were advocating for.
sentences.zh: 一方面是那个会去黑人教堂、能叫出领袖名字并了解他们所倡导诉求的邻居。

sentences.en: But then in Washington,
sentences.zh: 但另一方面在华盛顿，

sentences.en: you have a Joe Biden that is using those stories of Wilmington to kind of pass more tough on crime measures that some of that community say they weren't asking for.
sentences.zh: 你有一个乔·拜登，他利用在威尔明顿的那些故事来推动更多严厉打击犯罪的措施，而社区中的一些人表示他们并未要求这些措施。

sentences.en: In 1977, he first proposes mandatory minimums for drug sentences.
sentences.zh: 1977年，他首次提出针对毒品犯罪的法定最低刑期。

sentences.en: And through the 80s, in his connection with Strom Thurmond, they end up passing a really kind of significant set of bills.
sentences.zh: 在整个80年代，通过他与斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德（Strom Thurmond）的联系，他们最终通过了一套非常意义重大的法案。

sentences.en: Not enough prosecutors to convict them, not enough judges to sentence them, and not enough prison cells to put them away for a long time.
sentences.zh: 没有足够的检察官来定罪，没有足够的法官来判刑，也没有足够的监狱把他们长期关押。

sentences.en: In 1984, that establishes mandatory minimuMs.
sentences.zh: 1984年，这确立了法定最低刑期。

sentences.en: In 86, the Anti-Drug Abuse Act creates harsher sentences for crack than powder cocaine.
sentences.zh: 86年，《反药物滥用法》对快克可卡因制定了比粉末可卡因更严厉的刑罚。

sentences.en: And it kind of builds up into the early 90s, when Bill Clinton is elected president of the 94 bill.
sentences.zh: 这种情况一直持续到90年代初，当时比尔·克林顿当选总统并签署了94年法案。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Vice President, for your introduction and for your labors on this bill.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，副总统先生，感谢你的介绍以及你为这项法案所做出的努力。

sentences.en: The three strikes and you're out kind of policy.
sentences.zh: 就是那种“三振出局”的政策。

sentences.en: Three strikes and you're out will be the law of the land.
sentences.zh: “三振出局”将成为国家法律。

sentences.en: Or if you had three instances of drug offenses or violent drug offenses, it would be an instant life sentence.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你有三次毒品犯罪或暴力毒品犯罪的记录，就会被判处终身监禁，且不得假释。

sentences.en: We have the tools now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有了这些工具。

sentences.en: Let us get about the business of using them.
sentences.zh: 让我们着手开始使用它们吧。

sentences.en: And what do we understand about how the black community back in Delaware felt about these tough crime measures at the time?
sentences.zh: 那么我们如何理解当时特拉华州的黑人社区对这些严厉的犯罪措施的看法呢？

sentences.en: Joe Biden talks about, to this day, in his presidential campaign,
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登直到今天在他的总统竞选活动中仍然提到，

sentences.en: they make a big point to say that the Congressional Black Caucus overwhelmingly voted for the bill and that black leaders at the time were very supportive of the bill.
sentences.zh: 他们大肆宣称国会黑人核心小组以压倒性多数投票赞成该法案，并且当时的黑人领袖非常支持该法案。

sentences.en: That is partly true.
sentences.zh: 这部分是事实。

sentences.en: The Congressional Black Caucus certainly backed the bill after showing some initial wariness the majority of its members voted for.
sentences.zh: 在表现出最初的警惕之后，国会黑人核心小组确实支持了该法案，其多数成员投了赞成票。

sentences.en: There were some vocal black mayors who were calling for these particular measures.
sentences.zh: 当时有一些直言不讳的黑人市长呼吁采取这些具体的措施。

sentences.en: But there were also some who were against it.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些人对此表示反对。

sentences.en: This ill-conceived bill, fed by a media frenzy over crime, was on a fast track to the president's desk for signature by Christmas.
sentences.zh: 这项考虑不周的法案在媒体对犯罪的狂热炒作下，正以极快的速度送交总统办公室，以便在圣诞节前签署。

sentences.en: Jesse Jackson spoke out against it.
sentences.zh: 杰西·杰克逊大声疾呼反对它。

sentences.en: Spending several billion dollars on prisons and longer sentences is not the answer to reducing crime.
sentences.zh: 花费数十亿美元建造监狱和延长刑期并不是减少犯罪的答案。

sentences.en: The head of the Congressional Black Caucus spoke out against it.
sentences.zh: 国会黑人核心小组的负责人公开表示反对。

sentences.en: Representatives like Bobby Scott said they knew that the kind of increase of police in these neighborhoods would cause detrimental effects.
sentences.zh: 像鲍比·斯科特这样的众议员表示，他们知道在这些社区增加警察会导致有害的后果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what turns out to be, over time, the actual impact of all of these bills, including the biggest of them all, that 1994 crime bill, in the years it followed?
sentences.zh: 那么，随着时间的推移，所有这些法案（包括其中最大的一部，即1994年的犯罪法案）在随后的几年里产生的实际影响到底是什么？

sentences.en: The undeniable impact is an explosion of America's prison population that has disproportionately affected black and brown communities.
sentences.zh: 不可否认的影响是美国监狱人口的爆发式增长，这对黑人和棕色人种社区造成了不成比例的影响。

sentences.en: So coming out of the 80s and 90s, you have a pretty clear articulation from then-Senator Biden that cops and the expansion of cops is a preventative measure.
sentences.zh: 因此，从80年代和90年代走过来，你可以清楚地听到时任参议员拜登的表态，即警察以及警察队伍的扩大是一种预防措施。

sentences.en: In a nutshell, the president's plan doesn't include enough police officers to catch the violent thugs.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，总统的计划没有包含足够的警官来抓捕那些暴力暴徒。

sentences.en: He felt that the kind of presence of police officers, the increased presence of police officers in these communities, would inherently mean that crime would go down.
sentences.zh: 他认为，警察的存在，即在这些社区中警察数量的增加，本质上意味着犯罪率会下降。

sentences.en: As the years have gone on, it has become clear that the actual effect was not that, but was the disruption of the communities themselves.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，人们越来越清楚地看到，实际效果并非如此，而是对社区本身的破坏。

sentences.en: When I was in Wilmington talking to folks there, they were saying by 1994, it was already clear that the tough on crime kind of measures of the 80s weren't working on the streets.
sentences.zh: 当年我在威尔明顿与当地人交谈时，他们说到了1994年，人们就已经很清楚，80年代那种对犯罪采取强硬态度的措施在街头根本不起作用。

sentences.en: It was not decreasing crime, but more importantly, it was causing a kind of incarceration effect that didn't have the terminology for mass incarceration that we now call it.
sentences.zh: 它并没有减少犯罪，但更重要的是，它造成了一种监禁效应——当时我们还没有现在所称的“大规模监禁”这个词。

sentences.en: But it was clear that the kind of communities were getting ruptured by the increase in sentences and the increased focus on tough on crime measures.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，由于刑期的增加以及对严厉打击犯罪措施的日益关注，社区正在遭到破坏。

sentences.en: And of course, the legacy of busing is that we've seen a resegregation of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，校车接送政策的遗留问题是，我们看到了美国学校系统的重新隔离，

sentences.en: school system because the job was never really done.
sentences.zh: 因为这项工作从未真正完成。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: There is a narrative that busing failed, but the truth is kind of murkier.
sentences.zh: 有一种说法认为校车接送政策失败了，但事实其实更为扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Busing as a policy often did achieve its goals and racially integrate the places it was instituted.
sentences.zh: 作为一项政策，校车接送通常确实达到了其目标，并在其实施的地方实现了种族融合。

sentences.en: What failed was the political will to keep those measures in place that made integration happen and to see racial integration of schools as a necessary problem to solve.
sentences.zh: 失败的是保持这些实现融合的措施的政治意愿，以及将学校种族融合视为一个必须解决的问题的意愿。

sentences.en: So in the last decades, you have not only a return to pre-busing segregation levels,
sentences.zh: 因此，在过去的几十年里，不仅学校回到了校车接送政策实施前的隔离水平，

sentences.en: but in some places you have racial segregation in schools becoming even worse than they were or just as bad as they were at the time of Brown v.
sentences.zh: 而且在某些地方，学校的种族隔离甚至比当年《布朗诉教育委员会案》时还要严重，

sentences.en: Board of Education.
sentences.zh: 或者说和当年一样糟糕。

sentences.en: So instead, it seems like what we're seeing in the debate last week, in this exchange between Harris and Biden,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在上周的辩论中、在哈里斯和拜登的这场交锋中所看到的似乎是，

sentences.en: was that Biden is going to have to confront these past policies as their legacies are understood in the current moment.
sentences.zh: 拜登将不得不面对这些过去的政策，因为它们的遗留影响在当下正被人们重新审视。

sentences.en: And that means complicated legacies with real implications, many of them quite negative for the Black community.
sentences.zh: 这意味着复杂的历史遗产带来了现实的影响，其中许多对黑人社区来说是相当负面的。

sentences.en: Joe Biden is being, his whole record is being examined in new ways.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登的整个政治记录正以新的方式受到审视。

sentences.en: He's run for president twice before, but never as a frontrunner and never as someone who enjoys this amount of support among Black communities.
sentences.zh: 他以前曾两次竞选总统，但从未以领跑者的身份参选，也从未享有如今在黑人社区中如此规模的支持。

sentences.en: Remember, this is still the vice president to the first Black president.
sentences.zh: 请记住，他毕竟是第一位黑人总统的副总统。

sentences.en: This is still the person who is seen oftentimes as the most likely to beat President Trump in the Democratic Party,
sentences.zh: 他依然被许多人视为民主党内最有可能击败特朗普总统的人选，

sentences.en: which Black communities have often seen as their number one goal.
sentences.zh: 而黑人社区通常将此视为他们的首要目标。

sentences.en: So he's enjoying this kind of support, robust support among Black communities, while at the same time, his rivals are trying to use his record, particularly on busing and crime,
sentences.zh: 因此，他在黑人社区中享有这种大力支持，与此同时，他的竞争对手正试图利用他的记录（特别是在校车接送和犯罪问题上的记录），

sentences.en: to wrest away those votes.
sentences.zh: 来争夺这些选票。

sentences.en: And I think that's a really interesting question, is will these moments, like the one Senator Harris made happen in the debate,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常有趣的问题：像参议员哈里斯在辩论中制造的那样的时刻，

sentences.en: will they start to chip away at that image of him as a champion and an advocate for Black communities?
sentences.zh: 是否会开始动摇他作为黑人社区捍卫者和代言人的形象？

sentences.en: As people come to understand the record, as people come to understand the context of Delaware at the time, will he be seen as someone who was navigating a difficult racial terrain,
sentences.zh: 随着人们逐渐了解他的记录，随着人们逐渐了解当时特拉华州的背景，他会被视为一个在艰难的种族环境中摸索前行的人，

sentences.en: or as someone who kept Black people close, but fundamentally legislated in the interest of white communities?
sentences.zh: 还是一个表面上亲近黑人、但根本上是在为白人社区利益进行立法的人？

sentences.en: And so the question is, will voters evaluate him for what he was trying to accomplish in the 70s and the 80s and the 90s?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，选民会根据他在70年代、80年代和90年代试图完成的事业来评估他吗？

sentences.en: Or for what we now understand the impact of those bills to have been up through today?
sentences.zh: 还是会根据我们现在所理解的那些法案一直延续到今天的实际影响来评估他？

sentences.en: I wonder if you have any sense of how Black voters are seeing that from your reporting.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，从你的采访来看，你是否了解黑人选民对此有何看法？

sentences.en: I've spent a lot of time in South Carolina, where we have the biggest population of Black voters in the early states.
sentences.zh: 我在南卡罗来纳州呆了很长时间，那里在早期初选各州中拥有最大规模的黑人选民群体。

sentences.en: And Joe Biden enjoys a large amount of goodwill in those places.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在这些地方享有大量的民意基础。

sentences.en: What that is not is a deep connection to Joe Biden as an individual.
sentences.zh: 但这并不等于选民与乔·拜登个人之间存在着深厚的联系。

sentences.en: As I heard someone say recently, his support is wide, but it's thin.
sentences.zh: 正如我最近听到有人说的，他的支持面很广，但很薄弱。

sentences.en: And I think that people vote on a lot of different levels.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们在很多不同的层面上进行投票。

sentences.en: Voting based on policy and record is one of them.
sentences.zh: 基于政策和政治记录的投票是其中之一。

sentences.en: Voting based on emotion and feeling and connection is another.
sentences.zh: 基于情感、感觉和联系的投票是另一个层面。

sentences.en: And I think in this era, for Democrats, and particularly for Black Democrats, who feel as if Trump has brought in a new era of white identity politics,
sentences.zh: 我认为在这个时代，对于民主党人，尤其是那些觉得特朗普带来了白人身份政治新时代的黑人民主党人来说，

sentences.en: there is voting based on fear.
sentences.zh: 存在着基于恐惧的投票。

sentences.en: And what you hear in South Carolina is not that they want to vote for Joe Biden because they believe in the things that he has done.
sentences.zh: 你在南卡罗来纳州听到的并不是他们想投票给乔·拜登，因为他们信仰他所做过的事情。

sentences.en: But they see him as kind of an emergency fix to a much worse problem for them, which they believe is the presidency of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而是他们将他视为应对一个远比他们面临的更糟糕问题的“紧急修补方案”，他们认为那个更糟糕的问题就是唐纳德·特朗普的总统任期。

sentences.en: Asad, is what you're saying, that Black voters may be more inclined to go with a safe choice?
sentences.zh: 阿萨德，你的意思是，黑人选民可能更倾向于选择一个稳妥的选择吗？

sentences.en: Because in their mind, in this racial climate and in this political climate, the alternative, which is not winning the presidency,
sentences.zh: 因为在他们的心目中，在这种种族和政治气候下，另一种结果——也就是未能赢得总统宝座，

sentences.en: is far more threatening than a Democratic candidate with a debatable historical record on race.
sentences.zh: 要远远比一个在种族历史记录上存在争议的民主党候选人更具威胁性。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to make distinctions when we talk about Black voters.
sentences.zh: 我认为当我们谈论黑人选民时，做出区分是很重要的。

sentences.en: We particularly see that kind of calculation among older Black voters and Black voters who are in the South.
sentences.zh: 我们特别看到这种权衡较多地存在于年长的黑人选民和身处南方的黑人选民当中。

sentences.en: Now, among younger voters, we see a bigger willingness to reject Joe Biden because of some of those records
sentences.zh: 然而，在年轻选民中，由于其中一些历史记录，我们看到他们更愿意拒绝乔·拜登，

sentences.en: and to embrace candidates who are talking more explicitly and openly about structural changes to create racial equity.
sentences.zh: 并支持那些更明确、更公开地谈论结构性变革以实现种族公平的候选人。

sentences.en: But among the older voters who remain the real heart and soul of the Black vote and the sizable portion of the Democratic electorate,
sentences.zh: 但在那些依然是黑人选票真正核心与灵魂以及民主党选民中相当大比例的老年选民中间，

sentences.en: it's that calculation of safety that's really helping Joe Biden right now.
sentences.zh: 正是这种对安全的权衡在当下实实在在地帮助了乔·拜登。

sentences.en: But we should also say that among those older voters, many of them can remember 1994 and remember the 1980s
sentences.zh: 但我们也应该指出，在这些年长选民中，许多人还记得1994年，也记得20世纪80年代，

sentences.en: and may have themselves supported these bills and seen their thinking change as well.
sentences.zh: 他们自己可能也曾支持过这些法案，并且他们的想法也发生了改变。

sentences.en: And I think that's an important thing to not forget is just as Joe Biden has evolved, so have many of these people.
sentences.zh: 我认为有一点很重要，不能忘记：就像乔·拜登不断演变一样，许多这样的人也在演变。

sentences.en: And I've talked to people who don't see what he did as particularly invalidating, frankly, because they have experienced that same evolution.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的一些人坦率地认为，他所做过的事并非完全不可接受，因为他们自己也经历过同样的思想转变。

sentences.en: And sometimes I talk to people who said the 94 crime bill ruined their homes.
sentences.zh: 有时我与人交谈，他们说94年的犯罪法案毁了他们的家园。

sentences.en: And they will also say they can't wait to vote for Joe Biden in the primary.
sentences.zh: 但他们同时也会说，他们迫不及待地要在初选中投票给乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Before I start, I'd like to say something about the debate we had last night.
sentences.zh: 在我开始之前，我想先谈谈我们昨晚举行的辩论。

sentences.en: And I heard and I listened to and I respect Senator Harris.
sentences.zh: 我听到了哈里斯参议员的发言，也聆听并尊重她。

sentences.en: But, you know, we all know that 30 seconds to 60 seconds on a campaign debate exchange can't do justice to a lifetime committed to civil rights.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我们都知道，竞选辩论中短短30秒到60秒的交锋无法全面衡量一个人为民权奉献的一生。

sentences.en: Well, so, Ested, what do you make of how defensive Biden has been to these criticisms and these questions about his legacy?
sentences.zh: 那么，埃斯特德，对于拜登面对这些指责以及关于其历史遗产的质问时所表现出的防范姿态，你怎么看？

sentences.en: Rather than acknowledging, you know, a lot has changed since then.
sentences.zh: 而不是去承认，你知道的，自那以后发生了很多变化。

sentences.en: I was doing what I thought was best in the moment.
sentences.zh: 我当时做的是我认为在当时情况下最好的事。

sentences.en: I now see, I now understand that it played out differently than I expected.
sentences.zh: 我现在看到并理解了，事情的发展结果与我的预期有所不同。

sentences.en: This is a question I've thought a lot about.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我思考了很久的问题。

sentences.en: Now, if by the early 1990s, it was clear to the cops in the ground in Wilmington that the tough on crime measures didn't work,
sentences.zh: 如果早在20世纪90年代初，威尔明顿现场的警察就已经清楚地知道打击犯罪的强硬措施并不起作用，

sentences.en: that the disparities that were created in the 80s between crack and cocaine were disproportionately hurting Black communities,
sentences.zh: 知道80年代在快克和粉末可卡因之间造成的差异正在不成比例地伤害黑人社区，

sentences.en: why did it take until this year for Joe Biden to acknowledge it himself?
sentences.zh: 为什么直到今年乔·拜登才亲自承认这一点？

sentences.en: And we don't have clear answers to that.
sentences.zh: 对此我们并没有明确的答案。

sentences.en: I haven't always been right.
sentences.zh: 我并不总是对的。

sentences.en: I know we haven't always gotten things right.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们并非总能把事情做对。

sentences.en: But I've always tried.
sentences.zh: 但我一直在努力。

sentences.en: We know that Joe Biden very rarely apologized.
sentences.zh: 我们知道乔·拜登极少道歉。

sentences.en: But it's not until this year that you really have an articulation from Vice President Biden that he played a role as a senator in creating some of these disparities.
sentences.zh: 但直到今年，副总统拜登才真正明确表态，承认他在担任参议员期间对造成其中某些不平等现象负有责任。

sentences.en: Do you think it's possible that he might fear that if he apologizes, that that might weaken him more?
sentences.zh: 你认为有没有可能他担心一旦道歉，会让自己变得更加虚弱？

sentences.en: With moderate voters who who don't feel that Americans should have to apologize for that period, for those instincts and for those policies?
sentences.zh: 面对那些认为美国人不需要为那个时期、为那种直觉和那些政策道歉的温和派选民时，更是如此？

sentences.en: I think that's a big possibility.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很有可能。

sentences.en: I also think Joe Biden was acting in what he believes was good faith, even at that moment.
sentences.zh: 我也认为乔·拜登当时是在他认为出于善意的情况下行事的，即使是在那个时刻。

sentences.en: And what he thinks was the evidence in front of him and the context of the time.
sentences.zh: 并且根据他当时眼前的证据和当时的背景。

sentences.en: I think it's important to always go back to Delaware with him.
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的是始终把他带回到特拉华州的背景中去审视。

sentences.en: And in the moment that he comes up in, it is part of his personal and political identity that he was an advocate for the Black communities.
sentences.zh: 在他发迹的那个时期，成为黑人社区的捍卫者是他个人和政治认同的一部分。

sentences.en: And that he was performing a new role and, frankly, public service to those communities that white politicians had not done in that state.
sentences.zh: 而且他当时在扮演一个新的角色，坦率地说，是在为那些白人政治家在该州从未服务过的社区提供公共服务。

sentences.en: And so I think it's bigger than just the political realities of right now and what apologizing would mean.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这不仅超越了当下的政治现实以及道歉意味着什么，

sentences.en: To apologize would go to the heart of what his identity has been since he got in public office in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 道歉将触及他自20世纪70年代步入政坛以来其政治认同的核心。

sentences.en: And he's just not willing to apologize for that because, in fact, he's still proud of it.
sentences.zh: 而他根本不愿意为此道歉，因为事实上，他对此仍然感到骄傲。

sentences.en: The evidence in front of us tells us that's true.
sentences.zh: 我们眼前的证据告诉我们这是真的。

sentences.en: He was praising the crime bill just years ago.
sentences.zh: 就在几年前，他还在赞美这项犯罪法案。

sentences.en: And he has called it, at some points, his greatest accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 他在某些场合甚至称其为自己最伟大的成就。

sentences.en: And he has shown a real resistance to the many opportunities that activists and other rivals have given him to say that those actions were a mistake.
sentences.zh: 而且，对于激进人士和其他竞争对手给他的许多机会——让他承认当年的那些行动是个错误，他表现出了真正的抵触情绪。

sentences.en: Ested, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 埃斯特德，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来参加节目。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the Trump administration said it would end its attempts to ask about citizenship on the 2020 census, dropping the proposed question from the survey.
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普政府表示将终止在2020年人口普查中询问公民身份的企图，从调查问卷中删除了这一拟议的问题。

sentences.en: The decision comes just days after the Supreme Court ruled that the administration had failed to offer a compelling explanation for including the question,
sentences.zh: 就在几天前，最高法院裁定该政府未能为纳入该问题提供令人信服的解释，

sentences.en: which critics said was an attempt to discourage undocumented immigrants from filling out the census and ultimately skew the results of the census in favor of Republicans.
sentences.zh: 批评人士称，此举企图阻止无证移民填写人口普查表格，并最终歪曲普查结果以利于共和党人。

sentences.en: And House Democrats have filed a lawsuit against the Treasury Department and the Internal Revenue Service, demanding access to President Trump's tax returns.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党人已对财政部和国税局提起诉讼，要求获取特朗普总统的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: The lawsuit moves a month's old political dispute between Congress and the White House into the federal courts.
sentences.zh: 这起诉讼将国会与白宫之间持续数月的政治争端推向了联邦法院。

sentences.en: At the heart of the fight is whether Congress has the legal right to review the president's personal financial information.
sentences.zh: 这场争端的中心是国会是否拥有合法权利审查总统的个人财务信息。

sentences.en: The White House says that such requests must be limited to materials needed to draft laws.
sentences.zh: 白宫表示，此类请求必须仅限于起草法律所需的材料。

sentences.en: House Democrats say that their powers are far broader and are not subject to second-guessing by the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党人则表示，他们的权力要广泛得多，不受行政部门的置喙。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Friday after the holiday.
sentences.zh: 假期结束后，我们周五再见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让您的客宾至如归的实用小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是他们对光线有什么要求，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们爱喝咖啡还是爱喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用上或您喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索收听《Wirecutter秀》。
